description: This file appears to be a shell script used in the platform upgrade process for the Lantiq-based device in OpenWRT. It defines functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that always returns success, used to verify the image before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: A function that delegates to default_do_upgrade for performing the upgrade.
